premise: The closed global and local linear residual families do not test nonlinear associations between prior hidden-state signatures and the bytes subsequently observed. A decoder-built associative cache is a distinct information source.

primary_reference.title: Improving Neural Language Models with a Continuous Cache
primary_reference.scope: Prior art stores hidden-state/next-word pairs and retrieves by similarity. It supplies motivation, not Hutter evidence. No external implementation or parameter data is copied.

prospective_design: Reuse the verified pre-truth32ternary features; retain a bounded causal bank of signature/observed-next-byte pairs. Query neighbors before current truth, convert their labels into bit-prefix predictions, and test a protected-parent mixture. Every memory entry is derived from decoded bytes. Compare identical-capacity delayed-label control. Freeze capacity, similarity, tie-breaking, update clocks and any development grid before corpus access.
not_a_claim: No predicted savings, novelty claim, execution authorization or full-corpus score. Existing 34-byte expert-mixture evidence stays separate and is not added.
